lessons.title: What do I wear?
lessons.en:
Anna: What will you wear to the party, Ben?
Ben: I'll wear a white shirt and blue trousers.
Anna: Cool! I want to wear my pink skirt.
Ben: Don't forget your hat — the sun is strong.
Anna: OK! Let's go.
lessons.cn:
安娜：本，你穿什么去聚会？
本：白衬衫蓝裤子。
安娜：酷！我想穿粉色裙子。
本：别忘戴帽子，太阳大。
安娜：好，走吧！

lessons.title: My favourite clothes
lessons.en: I have many clothes in my closet. I wear T-shirts and shorts in summer. In spring, I like a light shirt and a pair of jeans. New shoes are always exciting. On rainy days, Mum tells me to wear my yellow boots. Clothes keep us warm and make us smile.
lessons.cn: 我衣柜里有很多衣服。夏天我穿 T 恤和短裤。春天我喜欢穿轻便衬衫和牛仔裤。新鞋总是让人兴奋。下雨天妈妈让我穿黄色雨靴。衣服让我们温暖，也让我们开心。
